about: [O3 critic] a beat cop put 5 m ahead (the only staging); I walk up and punch him, then hands off in the fist fight for 100 s: do I lose, warned?

steps.eval: (() => { const E = G.eye, y = G.controller.yaw, fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); G.people.dbgCop(E.x + fx * 5, E.z + fz * 5, Math.atan2(-fx, -fz)); return 'cop 5 m ahead'; })()

({ beat: G.scenes.beat, heat: G.police.heat, fail: G.lastFail && G.lastFail.why, say: [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent&&e.children.length===0&&e.innerText&&e.innerText.trim()).map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,40)).join(' | ') })
